Bobby Rivers hosts this Top 5 food countdown. Episodes look back at all-time leaders in some interesting categories like Top 5 movie treats, food fads or unforgettable slogans. There's even a show about the top five foods that taste like chicken. Humorous and historical, Top 5 recognizes the fabulous and the faux pas food items over the years.
